name: secondu-team-research-brief
description: Collect primary evidence, challenge it independently and prepare a traceable decision brief.

displayDescription.zh: 围绕明确问题收集一手依据、独立质疑，再整理可追溯的决策简报。
displayDescription.en: Collect primary evidence, challenge it independently and prepare a traceable decision brief.

quickPrompts.zh: 研究这个问题，保留一手来源、冲突证据和结论的适用条件。
quickPrompts.en: Research this question with primary sources, conflicting evidence and limits.

description.zh: 明确时间范围和决策问题；查找并实际打开原始来源。记录来源日期、关键事实、冲突和未知，不编造链接。交付 sources.csv 与 evidence.md。
description.en: Scope the time and decision. Open primary sources and record dates, facts, conflicts and unknowns without invented links. Deliver sources.csv and evidence.md.

description.zh: 独立核对最影响结论的事实、来源时效和推理跳跃；提出反例，区分有证据的反驳与仅仅可能。交付 review.md。
description.en: Independently check decisive facts, freshness and reasoning gaps; distinguish evidenced counterexamples from possibilities. Deliver review.md.

description.zh: 依据实际证据和复核结果写出结论、可选方案、条件与下一步。明确仍未解决的争议，所有关键事实可回到来源。交付 brief.md。
description.en: Synthesize evidence and review into a conclusion, options, conditions and next actions. Preserve unresolved disagreements and trace facts. Deliver brief.md.
